subject: valueBox linked to a menuItem with href

messages.author: fd2fc7e46319d1dd
messages.subject: valueBox linked to a menuItem with href
parts:
Hi all,

I have a shinydashboard I've created and here what I would like to achieve : when the user has clicked on the menuItem "menu1", in the main part of the dashboard, there is a valueBox ("box1" for instance), and I would like that when the user clicks on this valueBox, it goes to the content of the menuItem "menu2" (as if the user had clicked on the menuItem "menu2").

I've seen the "href" parameter for "valueBox" elements and it seems to work perfectly well if I use an external link (such as "www.google.fr/" for instance) but when I tried to use an internal link from the app itself, it doesn't work as expected...

Here is the example code I used :

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

shinyUI <- dashboardPage(

  dashboardHeader(title="Test"),
  
  dashboardSidebar( 
  
sidebarMenu(
             menuItem("Menu 1", tabName = "menu1", icon = icon("dashboard")), 
     menuItem("Exemples", tabName = "menu2", icon = icon("gears")),
             menuItem("Contre-exemples", tabName = "menu3", icon = icon("gears"))
)
   ),
   dashboardBody(   

    tabItems(
     
           tabItem(tabName = "menu1",
 
fluidRow( 
column(width = 5, 
valueBox(12, "exemples", color = "aqua", icon = icon("users"), href = "#shiny-tab-menu2", width = NULL)
),
column(width = 5,
valueBox(25, "contre-exemples", color = "maroon", icon = icon("users"), href = "#shiny-tab-menu3", width = NULL)
)
)
  ),
  
  tabItem(tabName = "menu2",
  
fluidRow( 
  column(width = 5, 
valueBox(12, "exemples", color = "aqua", icon = icon("users"), width = NULL)
  )
)
),
tabItem(tabName = "menu3",
  
fluidRow( 
  column(width = 5, 
valueBox(25, "contre-exemples", color = "maroon", icon = icon("users"), width = NULL)
  )
)
)
)

  )
  
)

And here what's happening for instance :

When I launch (in local) the app, I have the following adress in my navbar : http://127.0.0.1:4825/ , and I see the content of my menuItem "menu1" (by default).
Then, I click on the valueBox "box1" and nothing seems to change on the app : I still see the content of my menuItem "menu1" (instead of the content of "menu2") BUT in the navbar I have the following adresse : http://127.0.0.1:4825/#shiny-tab-menu2.
Then when I click directly on the menuItem "menu2", its content displays correctly, and after that, when I click on the menuItem "menu1", its content displays correctly too, eventhough I now still have http://127.0.0.1:4825/#shiny-tab-menu2 on my navbar.

> So I was wondering why the shinydashboard has this behavior and how to specify an internal href in order to link a valueBox to a menuItem ?

Don't hesitate to ask me if my description is not clear enough.
Thank you in advance for your help !

Best regards.
